content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. 💪 Research shows that loads from about 30% to 85% of your 1RM can all build muscle, as long as your sets get close to failure (roughly 0-3 reps left in the tank) and you do enough weekly volume.

Your goal is a 100 kg bench, though, so you do need heavy work. Strength is specific, and you get better at heavy singles and triples by practicing them. My advice is to keep your main bench work in the 3-8 rep range and use lighter 8-15 rep accessory work for extra muscle volume. Ain't nothin' but a peanut! 🔥
